What is the purpose of a watchdog timer in a microcontroller?
options: To provide a precise time‑of‑day clock
To reset the system if software becomes unresponsive
To generate PWM signals for motor control
To increase CPU clock speed dynamically
easy_conceptual.correct_answer: To reset the system if software becomes unresponsive

medium_application.text: When programming a microcontroller, you need to ensure that a variable shared between main code and an ISR is accessed atomically. Which C language construct is most appropriate?

A wearable health monitor needs to run for weeks on a small coin cell battery while sampling a temperature sensor once per second. Which microcontroller characteristic is most critical to meet this requirement?
An industrial controller must exchange 1 GB of data per second with a high‑speed camera. Which bus architecture would best satisfy the bandwidth requirement?
A motor control application needs to react to a fault condition within 10 µs. Which method should be used to detect the fault signal?
options: Polling the status register in the main loop
Configuring an external interrupt on the fault line
Checking the flag after each instruction execution
medium_application.correct_answer: Configuring an external interrupt on the fault line

medium_application.text: A bootloader must be stored in non‑volatile memory that can be updated without removing the chip from the board. Which memory type is most suitable?
To generate a 25 kHz PWM signal with a 12‑bit resolution on a timer with a 48 MHz system clock, what prescaler value should be programmed if the timer counts up to its maximum value?
During firmware development, a designer needs to set breakpoints and view register contents in real time. Which debug interface provides the most comprehensive access on modern ARM Cortex‑M devices?
An IoT node must reduce power consumption when no sensor data is needed for 5 minutes. Which low‑power mode should be entered to keep RAM contents while shutting down the CPU and most peripherals?
A microcontroller samples an 8‑bit ADC at 1 MS/s and must store the data in a buffer without CPU intervention. Which peripheral should be used to transfer the data to memory efficiently?
A digital signal processing (DSP) algorithm requires simultaneous access to program instructions and data samples. Which architecture is best suited for this workload?
To achieve an exact UART baud rate of 115200 bps with a 16 MHz crystal, which divisor should be programmed in the UART baud rate generator (assuming integer division only)?

hard_problem_solving.text: A microcontroller runs at 72 MHz with an average CPI of 1.5 for its main loop. The instruction cache miss penalty is 30 cycles, and the miss rate is 0.2 %. What is the average execution time (in microseconds) of a loop containing 400 instructions?

A 16‑bit timer peripheral runs from a 48 MHz peripheral clock. To generate a PWM signal of 20 kHz with a 37.5 % duty cycle, which values should be loaded into the period register (ARR) and the compare register (CCR) assuming up‑count mode?

A Moore state machine has states A, B, C, and D. The output is 1 only in state C. The transition table is: From A on input 0 → B, on 1 → C; From B on 0 → D, on 1 → A; From C on 0 → C, on 1 → D; From D on 0 → A, on 1 → B. If the machine starts in state A and receives the input sequence 1‑0‑1‑1‑0, what is the output sequence?

An 8‑bit microcontroller reads a 16‑bit ADC result stored in two registers ADCL (low byte) and ADCH (high byte) in left‑justified mode. After a conversion, ADCH contains 0xA3. What is the actual 10‑bit ADC value?

A low‑power MCU has three power states: Active (5 mA at 3 V), Sleep (0.5 mA at 3 V), and Deep‑Sleep (10 µA at 3 V). If the device spends 70 % of the time in Active, 20 % in Sleep, and 10 % in Deep‑Sleep, what is the average current consumption?

An I²C bus has a total capacitance of 400 pF. The I²C specification limits the maximum rise time (tr) to 300 ns. If the pull‑up resistor value is R, the rise time can be approximated by tr ≈ 0.847 · R · C. What is the maximum allowable pull‑up resistance?

In a 32‑bit RISC ISA, an ADD instruction format is: opcode[6:0] | rd[4:0] | funct3[2:0] | rs1[4:0] | rs2[4:0] | funct7[6:0]. If opcode for ADD is 0b0110011, funct3 is 0b000, funct7 is 0b0000000, rd = x5, rs1 = x10, rs2 = x15, what is the 32‑bit binary encoding of this instruction?

A peripheral is memory‑mapped at address range 0x4000 0000 to 0x4000 0FFF. Which of the following address decoding logic expressions correctly selects this peripheral using the highest 12 address lines (A31‑A20)?
